video_title: Ty Jerome's Trainer REVEALS What the NBA Didn't See Coming

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: Ty Jerome's early season performance and development
quotes.excerpt: He almost looks like a right-handed Brunson sometimes.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: Being in the area, you always hear Ty Jerome's name, but I didn't think he was going to start the season like this. He almost looks like a right-handed Brunson sometimes.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: So the bias in me wanted to say Ty Jerome. I've worked with him. He's killing it. Shout out to Kashif Pratt. I started working with him in ninth grade, our first workout. So that's damn near 13, 14 years ago. I've been seeing, and Melo has been seeing Ty Jerome play like this in the Black Ops runs, pulling off from half court. Everything he's doing now, we've been seeing. He just hasn't had, I think Steph just said it right in the interview, he's been had this, he just hasn't had the, he's been with Cleveland, we have Donovan Mitchell's main guy. Then before that, he was with the Warriors, he had Steph as the main guy. Before that, he was with SGA at OKC, I believe. So he's always had someone to defer to. Now it's his team.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on Ty Jerome's unique style of play
quotes.excerpt: Ty Jerome set a precedent that is hard to set.
quotes.quote: Ty Jerome set a precedent that is hard to set. You know, he's worked his way. Even his style of play, that could have hindered him sometimes along his career. I'm sure people said he's too slow, he's not athletic, he don't play, he a groundhog, he play below the rim. I'm sure he's heard that over and over and over.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: Ty Jerome's confidence and career path
quotes.excerpt: He says, I don't want to play for Houston, trade me.
quotes.quote: He was a lottery pick, won a national championship, went to OKC. They trade him to Houston. He says, I don't want to play for Houston, trade me. So in a position of nine of the ten players are just taking, I'm in the NBA, I don't want to do that. Which led him to the offseasons going and he doesn't have a team. The very end of the offseason, Golden State picked him up. But the confidence to be like, I don't want that, that just shows something. It just shows what he thinks about himself.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on watching Ty Jerome's development
quotes.excerpt: To see him doing what he's doing now, in workouts, my fucker will be one-legged, fading from half court.
quotes.quote: If you watch the game, and you watch basketball, you know Ty Jerome. You know him in college. You know he's a big-time guard coming out of New York. You know these things. And then you you start to follow him and his journey. To see him doing what he's doing now, in workouts, my fucker will be one-legged, fading from half court and it's like, I understood it. Because there's been times where I would be doing shit like that. You know what I mean? Shooting off the off the opposite foot. You know, just working on balance and footwork. And him banning those gems, I think gave him some of that confidence to like, damn, you know what, let me let me work on my footwork.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony's outlook on the Memphis Grizzlies
quotes.excerpt: I don't think it's sustainable for the team.
quotes.quote: I think it's sustainable for him, barring no injuries. I think it's sustainable for him. I don't think it's sustainable for the team. I don't know if I'm ready to say Memphis is that that team. I like where they're at. I like how they're building. I like how they kind of restructured a lot of things. They made some bold moves, so let Memphis let let Memphis build on that. You know, so you're going to take your your your bumps and bruises if you're a young team that way. You get what I'm saying? So you got some some great pillars. I mean, Ziaire Williams, player of the year.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the difficulty of the in-between game
quotes.excerpt: Being good at that game is tough. It's hard.
quotes.quote: That in-between game, like, being good at that game is tough. It's hard. That's why you don't see a lot of people able to do that. Those floaters, right foot, left foot, left hand, right hand, Ty Jerome, and like, Donovan started starting to like, you know, utilize that a lot more than one-legged floaters and runners and shit like that. But not a lot of people can play in that area, which makes Brunson exceptional, you know, which makes Ty Jerome when people see it like, oh shit, like, shorty can play. It's just when you're able to do something different that people don't no longer see anymore, and you bring them back to that, that's the beauty, that's the beauty in the art right there.
